_readme: One entry per app. The home page, the Apps page, each app page, the footer, the support page and the sitemap are all built from this list. See README.md › Adding an app.

apps.name: My Money
apps.summary: Track your shifts, earnings, payments and wallet in one simple place.
apps.description: My Money brings your shifts, what you'll be paid, the payments going out, the money you hold and your holiday allowance into one calm place. Everything is worked out on your phone and stays there.
highlights: Keep track of cash and card
Your records stay on your device

screens.title: Calendar
screens.text: Each pay period is a calendar. Tap a day to record a shift, a holiday or a sick day. Colour makes the month easy to read: paid holidays in amber, paid sick days in red, extra money in green and days off shaded grey, with the icons and words kept too. Paydays are marked.
screens.alt: My Money Calendar screen showing a four-week pay period with shifts, an amber holiday, a red sick day, green extra money and shaded days off
screens.headline: Record shifts, hours, holidays and earnings, in colour.

screens.title: Overview
screens.text: Overview adds up the estimated income from every job, the payments due this month, and what is left over.
screens.alt: My Money Overview screen for November showing the amount left over, estimated income from two jobs and payments
screens.headline: Understand earnings and payments at a glance.

screens.title: Payments
screens.text: Rent, bills and one-off costs live in one list. Tick them off as you pay and see how much is still to go.
screens.alt: My Money Payments screen listing bills with paid and due amounts
screens.headline: Organise recurring and one-off payments.

screens.title: Wallet
screens.text: Record money in, money out and transfers, and always know what you hold in cash and on card. A pay-period summary shows what came in and went out, split into cash and card.
screens.alt: My Money Wallet screen showing total, cash and card balances, money in and out for the pay period, and recent transactions
screens.headline: Track cash and card balances.

screens.title: Holiday allowance
screens.alt: My Money Holiday Allowance screen showing 28 days allowance, 1 day used and 27 days remaining for the holiday year
screens.headline: Know how much holiday you have left.
screens.text: Set your employer's holiday year and allowance, in days or hours. Holidays you add in the Calendar are counted automatically, and you can add adjustments.

screens.title: Settings and tools
screens.alt: My Money Settings screen listing jobs, pay periods and tools such as Pay Calculator and Payday Countdown
screens.headline: Handy tools, built in.
screens.text: A calculator, a pay calculator, a payday countdown, a side-by-side job comparison and an hours-needed tool, next to your jobs and pay periods.

features.title: Shifts your way
features.text: Split shifts, several shifts a day, overtime, holidays and sick days, with extra money on any day.

features.title: Several jobs, one view
features.text: Each job keeps its own pay rate, pay period and payday. Overview adds them together.

features.title: Estimated take-home pay
features.text: Gross and estimated take-home pay from your own rates and deduction setting, with the pay for each line of hours in the period breakdown.

features.title: Optional app lock
features.text: A 4- or 6-digit PIN, with fingerprint, face or Face ID, locking straight away or after 1 or 5 minutes.

features.title: Backups you keep
features.text: Save a backup file wherever you like and restore it on a new phone.

apps.privacy: No account, no server and no bank connection. Your records are stored only on your phone and never sent to us, and your app lock PIN itself is never stored. No adverts and no analytics, on Android and iPhone.
apps.pricing: Free to download. My Money Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited jobs and advanced pay adjustments. No subscription.

ios.note: In testing with TestFlight, App Store release in preparation

support.q: How do I get My Money Pro back on a new phone?
support.a: Sign in to the same Google or Apple account you bought it with, open My Money, go to Settings → My Money Pro and tap Restore purchase.

support.q: How do I move my records to a new phone?
support.a: On the old phone, go to Settings → Backup & restore and save a backup file somewhere you can reach from the new phone, such as Google Drive or iCloud Drive. On the new phone, open the same screen and choose that file.

support.q: How do I track my holiday allowance?
support.a: Go to Settings → Jobs, choose the job, then Holiday Allowance → Track Allowance. Set when your holiday year starts and your allowance in days or hours. Holidays you add in the Calendar are then counted automatically.
No. Your records are only on your phone, so there is never a copy on our side. Saving a backup regularly is the best protection.
No. My Money has no adverts and no analytics, on Android and iPhone. If you still see an advert on Android, update the app from Google Play.

support.q: How do I delete all my data?
support.a: Uninstall My Money, or on Android clear its storage in Settings → Apps → My Money → Storage. Delete any backup files you saved as well.

support.q: How do I get a refund?
support.a: Purchases are handled by Google Play or Apple. Request a refund through Google Play (play.google.com → Order history) or Apple (reportaproblem.apple.com).

apps.name: Habit Dial
apps.summary: A simple circular habit tracker that makes daily progress easy to see.
apps.description: Habit Dial turns each month into a single dial. Every habit is a ring, every day is a segment, and a glance shows how the month is going. It works offline, with nothing to sign up for.
highlights: Track up to eight daily habits
See the whole month on one dial
Mark a habit done with one tap
Optional reminders on the days you choose
Habits stored only on your phone

screens.title: The dial
screens.text: Each habit is a ring and each day a segment. Today is marked, and the centre shows how many habits you have done.
screens.alt: Habit Dial showing November as a circular dial with six coloured habit rings and 3 of 6 habits completed today
screens.headline: The whole month on one dial.

screens.title: Today
screens.text: Tap a habit when you have done it today. Tap again to undo.
screens.alt: Habit Dial list of today's habits with three marked as done
screens.headline: One tap to mark it done.

screens.title: New habit
screens.alt: Habit Dial New habit sheet with a name field and a choice of colours
screens.headline: Add a habit in seconds.
screens.text: Give it a name and a colour. Changes apply to the current month, so each month can have its own habits.

steps.title: Set up your habits
steps.text: Add up to eight daily habits for the month and give each one a colour. Each habit becomes a ring on the dial.

steps.title: Mark today's progress
steps.text: Tap a habit when you've done it. The matching segment on the dial fills in straight away.

steps.title: See the month at a glance
steps.text: The dial shows every day of the month, so streaks and gaps are easy to spot without charts or scores.

features.title: Light and dark
features.text: Follows your phone's appearance, or choose one yourself.

features.title: Reminders
features.text: An optional reminder for each habit, on the days you choose. Skipped once you have ticked it.

features.title: Optional App Lock
features.text: A 4- or 6-digit PIN, with fingerprint or face unlock. Habit Dial is hidden in the recent-apps screen while it's on.

features.title: Backups you keep
features.text: Create a backup file yourself and restore it when you need to.

apps.privacy: No account, no server, no cloud sync, no adverts and no analytics. Your habits are stored only on your phone, encrypted, and Android's cloud backup is turned off for the app. Reminders are created and shown on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere.
apps.pricing: Free to download, with a three-day trial of all eight habits. One habit stays free forever; a one-time lifetime unlock adds all eight. No subscription.

support.q: How do I restore the lifetime unlock on a new phone?
support.a: Sign in to Google Play with the account you bought it with. Habit Dial checks your purchase with Google Play when it opens.

support.q: How do I move my habits to a new phone?
support.a: Create a backup file in Habit Dial's Settings, keep it somewhere you can reach from the new phone, then restore it there. Android cloud backup is turned off for the app, so it won't copy your habits by itself.

support.q: I forgot my App Lock PIN.
support.a: Use fingerprint or face unlock if you turned it on. If not, the only way back in is to clear the app's data in Android settings, which also deletes your habits unless you have a backup.

Check that notifications are on for Habit Dial in your phone’s Settings → Apps → Habit Dial → Notifications, and that battery saving isn’t stopping the app. Reminders can arrive a few minutes late while the phone saves battery. There’s no reminder on a day you’ve already ticked the habit. If you haven’t opened Habit Dial for three weeks, reminders pause until you open it again.

support.q: How do I delete all my data?
support.a: In Habit Dial, go to Settings → Delete all data. Uninstalling the app also deletes everything.

support.q: How do I get a refund?
support.a: Purchases are handled by Google Play. Request a refund through Google Play (play.google.com → Order history).

apps.name: SpottedWise
apps.summary: Find and share deals near you in the UK, checked by the people who use them.
apps.description: SpottedWise brings local deals into one place: lunch offers, happy hours, things to do, shopping and everyday services. Deals are shared by the community, and people say whether a deal is still on, so you can see when it was last checked.
highlights: Browse local deals without an account
Five categories, from food to everyday services
See when each deal was last checked
Save deals and share them with friends
Add a deal you've spotted in a few steps

screens.title: Offers
screens.alt: SpottedWise Offers screen listing nearby deals with prices, times and when each was last checked
screens.headline: Deals near you, at a glance.
screens.text: Choose a town, a postcode or your current location and a distance. Each deal shows the price, when it's on next and when someone last checked it.

screens.title: Deal details
screens.alt: SpottedWise deal page for a burger, fries and shake at £11.95, showing what's included, conditions and times
screens.headline: Everything you need to know.
screens.text: What's included and what isn't, the conditions, the days and times, and where to find it. Save it for later or share it with a friend.

screens.title: Add a deal
screens.alt: SpottedWise Add a deal screen with a place search and five deal categories
screens.headline: Spotted one? Share it.
screens.text: Find the place, then type the offer, or scan a leaflet or menu and your phone fills it in for you to check. Deals you share help everyone nearby save.

features.title: Checked by the community
features.text: People say whether a deal is still on, so you can see when it was last confirmed.

features.title: Search your way
features.text: Look by town or postcode, or use your location only if you choose to.

features.title: Saved deals
features.text: Keep the deals you like in one list. Sign in and they follow you to your other devices.

features.title: Fair and moderated
features.text: Anyone can report a deal that's wrong, and reports are reviewed. Businesses can ask for corrections.

apps.privacy: Browsing needs no account. Location is optional: your exact position stays on your phone, and only an approximate location, rounded to about 1 km, is used to find nearby deals. Contributors sign in with an email address, which is never shown to anyone. SpottedWise has no analytics of its own. Adverts are non-personalised and come from Google AdMob, which receives some device and usage information; the privacy policy explains what.

ios.note: In preparation for the App Store

extra.label: Delete your account
extra.summary: In the app or by email
extra.title: Delete your SpottedWise account
extra.desc: How to delete your SpottedWise account, in the app or by email.

support.a: No. You can browse, search and save deals without one. You only sign in, with your email address, to add deals, confirm whether a deal is still on, or report one. Contributors must be 18 or over.

support.q: A deal is wrong or has ended. What can I do?
support.a: Open the deal and say it's no longer on, or report it. Reports are reviewed, and deals that are wrong are corrected or removed.

support.q: I run a business. How do I correct or remove its details?
support.a: Email contact@ionutcm.com with the business name and address and what needs to change.

support.q: How do I delete my account?
support.a: In the app, sign in and go to Settings › Account › Delete my account. Or email contact@ionutcm.com from the address you sign in with, with the subject "Delete my SpottedWise account".
